resources.string: Choose a name that makes sense to you. This will be shown on the app icon and the Quick Settings tile.

To use this toggle, you must grant settings permissions through root or run this ADB command on your computer with USB debugging enabled:\n\nadb shell pm grant com.ericlowry.dnstoggle android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS
When enabled, the app will be hidden from your app drawer. You can still access settings by long-pressing the Quick Settings tile.
Show a status notification when Private DNS is toggled via the Quick Settings tile.
The app needs a special permission to change Private DNS settings.
Private DNS cannot be enabled while host address is empty
DNS server unreachable on port 853 (DoT). Android may still successfully connect via other methods.
Enable this only if your DNS works but the app shows it as unreachable.
Location/Nearby permission (including background) required to verify the Wi-Fi SSID.
Location and Nearby devices permissions have been permanently denied. Please enable them in App Settings to use this feature.
To notify you when Private DNS is automatically toggled in the background, and ensure monitoring remains active, please allow notifications.

To monitor Wi-Fi while the app is closed, Android requires \"Allow all the time\" location access. DNS Toggle only uses this to see the Wi-Fi name, and never tracks your physical location or uses GPS.
\n\nNote: Active VPN connections may mask your Wi-Fi network name, temporarily disabling auto-blacklist/whitelist rules.
Due to a change in your device\'s security settings (like changing your screen lock), your Wi-Fi blacklist was reset to protect your data. You will need to re-add your blacklisted networks.
DNS Toggle is active to automate Private DNS mode.
To support automatic toggling, the app monitors network changes. The impact on battery consumption should be minimal, but the system may still report background activity.
Some devices kill background monitoring to save battery. If automation stops working, disable restrictions for this app.
